instruction: Search for new language model papers from October 11, 2023 on arXiv and add them to the spreadsheet with dates in YYYY.M.D format.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding language model papers from Oct 11, 2023 on arXiv and adding them to spreadsheet with dates in YYYY.M.D format (e.g., 2023.10.11). Baseline file has 2 papers. Evaluator verifies: (1) new papers were added (row count > 2), (2) all dates follow YYYY.M.D format, (3) at least 1 paper with date 2023.10.11 is present, (4) at least 1 language model paper from Oct 11 2023 is present (verified via title keyword matching).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: (1) new papers added to spreadsheet (metric checks total_papers > baseline_row_count at line 36), (2) papers are about language models (getter extracts LM keywords at lines 48-54,77-78; metric verifies at lines 55-60), (3) papers from October 11, 2023 (getter checks date '2023.10.11' at lines 90-94; metric verifies at lines 48-53), (4) dates in YYYY.M.D format (getter validates with regex at line 72; metric checks at lines 41-46)

Getter logic is sound: reads Excel file correctly, extracts paper entries from rows, validates date format using pattern '^\d{4}\.\d{1,2}\.\d{1,2}$', identifies language model papers via comprehensive keyword list (language model, llm, transformer, gpt, bert, nlp, etc.), tracks Oct 11 papers and LM papers separately

Metric logic is correct: handles expected parameter properly (line 26 - directly accesses rules dict when type='rule'), performs comprehensive validation with appropriate failure conditions, verifies all requirements must be met for success (new papers, date formatting, Oct 11 papers, LM papers)
Postconfig is appropriate: activates LibreOffice window and saves file with Ctrl+S to ensure file state is persisted before reading
Edge cases handled: empty rows skipped (getter:64-65), missing values handled (getter:68), returns zero structure if file not found (getter:27-35)
Expected values are semantically correct: baseline_row_count=2 matches metadata explanation, min_papers_required=1 is reasonable, require_all_formatted=true matches instruction requirement
